locations.note: Kurt Dierker shoots out Sean's tyre to win the 1940 Saarbrücken Grand Prix; when Sean and Jules break into the Doppelsieg factory for revenge, Dierker tortures Jules to death. Sean later returns to blow up the factory and its atomic project.
Living above the Belle Du Nuit cabaret, Sean joins Luc Gaudin's resistance, kills Nazi officers and blows up installations until the occupied city rises up.
On his first job with Luc, Sean blows up the fuel tanks at the depot by the Gare de l'Est, and later kills Colonel Gower in the red-light district beside it.
Skylar brings Sean to her British SOE contacts, who send him to recover a box hidden in a mausoleum and take him into their fight.
In disguise, Sean drives a tank across the Louvre complex to blow up a German tower.
Sean climbs the scaffolding at the back of the church to a sniper's nest and covers Dr. Kwong's escape from the rooftop.
In a German uniform, Sean climbs up through the Panthéon to the big gun mounted on top and blows it up with RDX.
The game makes it the Gestapo headquarters: Sean breaks in through a window, fights down through the library and cells, blows the boiler and gets Maria Kessler out.
The resistance's headquarters; when the Nazis attack it, Sean holds them off with a machine gun and dynamite and drives Skylar and the Kesslers to the catacombs.
The resistance flees into the catacombs when its headquarters is raided; in the later Nazi attack there, Veronique has to kill the trapped Luc.
Sean single-handedly rescues Veronique, who is being readied for execution at Notre-Dame.
Sean tracks Dierker to the Eiffel Tower, where he is executing his own men, and confronts him at the top.

routes.name: Sean Devlin
routes.note: From the rigged Grand Prix in Saarbrücken to the resistance in Paris, back to destroy the Doppelsieg factory and up the Eiffel Tower after Dierker.
